name: smwmusic-soleil-musique-liberation-sol-battle021-mid
title: soleil-musique - Liberation ('sol_battle021.mid')
description:
A cool battle theme from an obscure Japanese MIDI website. The only reason I ported this is because two other people here named Core/BeniBoD and OGS93 ported it a decade ago for a hack called 'Hira's Untold Story' but back then, the source was unknown until recently Core found it. I felt interested, so I ported it from scratch.

Original MIDI: http://soleilmusique.web.fc2.com/music_index.html

Core and OGS93's ports: https://smwc.me/1214385
